sara: quick thought  we flip to proactive degradation when pool headroom < X instead of waiting for scale-up.
matt: curious how you'd degrade. evict? drop burst tokens?
sara: staged: 1) reduce burst tokens (30s TTL), 2) downgrade to quantized variant (60s), 3) eviction if sustained.
anya: add warmth score check before eviction  warm tenants shouldn't be evicted.
paul: need signal back to SDKs so product teams know it's a fallback. header or response field?
infra-bot: canary toggle set in stg: "proactive_degrade=true" (runbook: https://internal.runbook/degrade-playbook)
matt: agree on telemetry: metric "degrade.action" tags: pool, tenant, action, reason.
sara: let's iterate a small RFC + sim harness. i'll draft heuristic table. everyone ok with owners: sara, matt, anya?
anya: yep. keep thresholds tunable per-pool. :thumbsup:
